description: Milestone 3 Steps 7-9 screening thresholds and service reallocation rules for Manhattan bus routes (split by weekday and weekend day groups).

fewer_trips_screening.note: Targets (route, time_band, day_group) cells with low predicted riders per service-hour (<= 22.0) and rare threshold exceedances (<= 15.0%).

more_trips_screening.note: Targets (route, time_band, day_group) cells with high riders per service-hour (>= 40.0) and frequent hours above 0.96x threshold_p75 (>= 65.0%), excluding tiny-denominator outliers such as M35.

coverage_guardrails.note: Routes serving >=60% exclusive stops cannot be discontinued or deeply cut without losing unique street coverage; cap trims at -10%.

shared_corridor_overlap.note: Merge feasibility checks apply strictly to shared_corridor pairs (>=40% overlap share) and exclude same_family variants (M15/M15+, M34+/M34A+, M14A+/M14D+).

step8_9_adjustment_rules.demand_assumption_statement: Assumes total ridership stays constant when scheduled trips change (+/-10% or +/-20%), isolating arithmetic changes in riders per trip, riders per service-hour, and hours exceeding the high-demand threshold.
